lines.text: This frog freezes solid every winter, and its heart stops.

parts.tts: This frog freezes solid every winter, and its heart stops.
parts.heard: This frog freezes solid every winter, and its heart stops.

lines.text: It's the wood frog, the only North American frog found north of the Arctic Circle.

parts.tts: It's the wood frog, the only North American frog found north of the Arctic Circle.
parts.heard: It's the Wood Frog, the only North American frog found north of the Arctic Circle.

lines.text: But in winter, up to two thirds of the water in its body turns to ice.

parts.tts: But in winter, up to two thirds of the water in its body turns to ice.
parts.heard: But in winter, up to two-thirds of the water in its body turns to ice.

lines.text: No heartbeat. No breathing. No blood flow.

parts.tts: No heartbeat. No breathing. No blood flow.
parts.heard: No heartbeat. No breathing. No blood flow.

lines.text: But how does it survive? Its liver floods its body with sugar.

parts.tts: But how does it survive? Its liver floods its body with sugar.
parts.heard: But how does it survive? Its liver floods its body with sugar.

lines.text: That sugar works like antifreeze, so ice can't form inside its cells.

parts.tts: That sugar works like antifreeze, so ice can't form inside its cells.
parts.heard: that sugar works like antifreeze, so ice can't form inside its cells.

lines.text: But in Alaska, it goes further: frozen for up to 218 days.

parts.tts: But in Alaska, it goes further: frozen for up to two hundred eighteen days.
parts.heard: But in Alaska, it goes further, frozen for up to 218 days.

lines.text: And before winter sets in, it can freeze and thaw again and again.

parts.tts: And before winter sets in, it can freeze and thaw again and again.
parts.heard: and before winter sets in, it can freeze and thaw again and again.

lines.text: Then spring comes. It thaws out and comes back to life.

parts.tts: Then spring comes. It thaws out and comes back to life.
parts.heard: Then spring comes. It thaws out and comes back to life.

lines.text: And it hops off to a pond to breed... like winter never happened.

parts.tts: And it hops off to a pond to breed...
parts.heard: and it hops off to a pond to breed.
